title: Embed Gatekeeper: Canary + Per-tenant Version Pinning and Rollback Playbook
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Goal: Add a robust 'Embed Gatekeeper' flow for onboarding new embedding model versions that enforces quality, latency, and cost constraints while enabling per-tenant version pinning and fast rollback. This work spans: automated canary evaluation, drift and quality thresholds, quantization compatibility checks, end-to-end latency budgets for the reranking endpoint, cost delta estimation, and an operator-facing rollback/playbook. The ticket covers design, infra changes, telemetry, tests, and runbook docs.
acceptance_criteria: 1) New model can be deployed to production with an automated canary that runs synthetic and sampled traffic checks. 2) Canary emits pass/fail signals for quality (embedding cosine drift vs baseline), P50/P95 latency, and token-cost delta. 3) Per-tenant pinning API allows admins to pin tenants to a specific model version (create/read/delete). 4) Operator UI shows canary health with drilldowns and a single-click rollback that routes traffic back to previous version. 5) Rollback completes within configured SLA (90s) and has a verified no-loss path for in-flight requests. 6) Telemetry feeds available in the Console (cost/latency/quality).
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Canary infra (2 weeks) - implement lightweight canary runner that replays sampled requests through candidate model; integrate with existing inference gateway; add metrics export (cosine_drift, rerank_ndcg_sampled, p50_latency, p95_latency, cost_per_request). Phase 2: Tenant pinning and routing (1.5 weeks) - persist per-tenant model pins in Config DB, extend router to honor pin, add API + Console controls. Phase 3: Rollback and runbook (1 week) - implement single-click rollback, ensure KV cache warm-path fallback, create operator playbook and safety checks. Phase 4: QA and perf validation (1 week) - run stress tests for embedding throughput, validate batching impact, and verify quantized variant compatibility. Phase 5: Launch and monitoring (ongoing) - dashboarding, alerts, and post-launch sample audits.
rollout_plan: 1) Internal canary: enable on 5% of internal test traffic for 48h. 2) External beta: allow opt-in for 3 pilot customers via tenant pin API; monitor for 7 days. 3) Gradual ramp: 0% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% across non-pin customers with automated gate checks at each step. 4) Full deprecation window: when sunsetting older version, notify pinned tenants and provide migration guidance; refuse automatic swap until pin removed or tenant approves. 5) Emergency rollback: authorized operators can trigger immediate rollback; system performs health-checks and warms primary KV cache before switching.
telemetry_metrics: cosine_drift_by_tenant, rerank_ndcg_sampled, embed_p50_latency_ms, embed_p95_latency_ms, cost_delta_per_1k_requests, canary_pass_rate, in_flight_request_count, rollback_duration_seconds
QA_notes: - Include fuzzed queries with heavy sequence length and long doc contexts. - Verify quantized 8-bit and float16 variants under same canary harness. - Ensure KV cache warm path correctness when switching versions (prefix collisions). - Validate per-tenant pinned routing under high-concurrency (5000 RPS) and observe tail latencies.
